main.description: Enumerate notifications for the requesting account, pre-grouped for rendering. Supersedes listNotifications. Requires auth.

filter.description: Which notification feed to return. Grouping behavior and the application of the account's notification preferences vary per feed: 'all' and 'people-i-follow' respect notification preferences, while dedicated feeds do not.

utcOffset.description: Offset from UTC in minutes, positive east, used to determine local day boundaries when grouping. Groups never span a local day boundary. Defaults to UTC.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return.

groups.description: Notification groups, newest first. Clients should ignore group types they do not recognize.

likeGroup.description: One or more likes on the same post.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

actors.description: Sample of the actors who liked the post, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

count.description: Total number of likes in this group.

multiPostLikeGroup.description: One actor liked multiple posts by the requesting account.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

actor.description: The actor who liked the posts.

posts.description: Sample of the liked posts, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

postUris.description: URIs of every liked post in this group, newest first. Hydrate with app.bsky.feed.getPosts to display the full list.

count.description: Total number of likes in this group.

repostGroup.description: One or more reposts of the same post.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

actors.description: Sample of the actors who reposted the post, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

count.description: Total number of reposts in this group.

likeViaRepostGroup.description: One or more likes on a repost of the same post.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

post.description: The subject post of the repost that was liked.

actors.description: Sample of the actors who liked the repost, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

count.description: Total number of likes in this group.

repostViaRepostGroup.description: One or more reposts of a repost of the same post.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

post.description: The subject post of the repost that was reposted.

actors.description: Sample of the actors who reposted the repost, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

count.description: Total number of reposts in this group.

followGroup.description: One or more accounts followed the requesting account.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

actors.description: Sample of the accounts that followed, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

count.description: Total number of follows in this group.

starterPack.description: Present when the follows in this group all originated from the same starter pack. Follows via different starter packs are never grouped together.

subscribedPostGroup.description: One or more new posts from an account the requesting account has an activity subscription to.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

posts.description: Sample of the new posts, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

postUris.description: URIs of every new post in this group, newest first. Hydrate with app.bsky.feed.getPosts to display the full list.

count.description: Total number of posts in this group.

generatorLikeGroup.description: One or more likes on the same feed generator.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this group, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when every notification in this group has been seen.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the newest notification in this group.

generator.description: The feed generator that was liked.

actors.description: Sample of the actors who liked the feed generator, newest first. May contain fewer entries than count.

count.description: Total number of likes in this group.

replyNotification.description: A reply to a post by the requesting account, or to a thread they are participating in.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

quoteNotification.description: A post quoting a post by the requesting account.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

post.description: The post containing the quote. Its embed includes the quoted post.

parent.description: The post being replied to, when the quoting post is itself a reply.

mentionNotification.description: A post mentioning the requesting account.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

parent.description: The post being replied to, when the mentioning post is itself a reply.

followBackNotification.description: An account followed the requesting account back.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

actor.description: The account that issued the verification.

unverifiedNotification.description: A verification of the requesting account was removed.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

actor.description: The account that removed the verification.

starterPackJoinedNotification.description: An account joined Bluesky via a starter pack created by the requesting account.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.

starterPack.description: The starter pack that was joined.

contactMatchNotification.description: A contact of the requesting account joined Bluesky.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this notification, unique within the notification feed. Clients must not attempt to derive meaning from it.

isRead.description: True when this notification has been seen.
